newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-General Cable started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-General Cable started as buy.

text.p: Morgan Stanley said on Friday it initiated coverage of General Cable Plc with a "strong buy" on a valuation basis.
AT 1057 GMT, the shares were trading at 178p, unchanged on the day.
The brokerage said it had a price target of 262p.

Morgan Stanley said it was bullish on the entire sector, but was most positive about General Cable's prospects because of the company's high exposure to the fast growing telecommunications industry. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
